@local_factor = 1.5

tech_starbase_5 = {
	cost = @tier4cost1
	area = engineering
	tier = 4
	category = { voidcraft }
	prerequisites = { "tech_starbase_4" }
	weight = @[ tier5weight1 * 2 ]
}

tech_battleships = {
	cost = @tier4cost1
	area = engineering
	tier = 4
	category = { voidcraft }
	weight = 10
}

# Mega-Engineering hides Battleships in its availability conditions.
tech_mega_engineering = {
	cost = @tier5cost1
	area = engineering
	tier = 5
	category = { voidcraft }
	prerequisites = { "tech_starbase_5" "tech_zero_point_power" }
	is_rare = yes
	potential = {
		OR = {
			has_technology = tech_battleships
			has_technology = tech_stingers
		}
		NOT = { has_ethic = ethic_gestalt_consciousness }
	}
	weight = @tier5weight1
	weight_modifier = {
		factor = 0.25
		modifier = {
			factor = @local_factor
			num_owned_planets >= 10
		}
		inline_script = { script = technologies/curator_boost FACTOR = 2 }
	}
	modifier = {
		country_resource_max_add = 20000
		megastructure_build_speed_mult = 0.25
	}
	prereqfor_desc = {
		feature = { title = "MEGASTRUCTURE_RESTORATION" desc = "MEGASTRUCTURE_RESTORATION_DESC" }
	}
}

tech_repeatable_hull = {
	cost = 50000
	area = engineering
	tier = 5
	levels = -1
	category = { materials }
	prerequisites = { "tech_mega_engineering" }
	weight = 0
}
